0Google reviews for KLM so far
01

The map is wide open

The top San Tan Valley map listing has a single review. A handful of real reviews and a correct Google profile put KLM in that race.

02

Your Google profile says medical

It's listed as a home health care service, which is medical care, and the hours read wrong. Families searching for bathing help may skip past it.

03

The site can't show proof yet

The testimonials on klmhomecare.com are placeholder text. Real reviews and your own photos are what families trust.

04

Families search broad words

Hardly anyone searches "bathing assistance". They search home care, in-home caregiver and respite care, so those are the pages to build.

guarantee.title: 180-day guarantee
text: If after 180 days of following the recommended strategy Client does not see measurable improvement in visibility and lead generation, Provider continues the monthly work at no additional cost until Client does.

Measurable improvement means any of the following, compared with the baseline Provider documents from Client's own accounts in the first 14 days: a ranking lift on tracked keywords, a lift in organic traffic, or qualified leads delivered through paid channels.

The guarantee requires the monthly services in this agreement to stay active for the 180 days and Client to meet the responsibilities in the terms below. It does not cover ad spend and is not a refund.

general.title: Client Responsibilities
general.text: Client agrees to: provide feedback within 3 business days of receiving deliverables; provide all required content, images, logos, and brand assets within 5 business days of signing; designate a single point of contact; provide access to hosting, domain, and relevant accounts.

general.title: Provider Responsibilities
general.text: Provider agrees to: deliver all services outlined in the Scope of Work; maintain regular communication and provide progress updates; meet agreed-upon deadlines, barring delays caused by Client.

general.title: Acceptance Criteria
general.text: Client has 7 business days to review and approve each deliverable. If no response is received within 7 business days, the deliverable will be considered approved. Revision requests must be submitted in writing within this period.

general.title: Revisions and Changes
general.text: This agreement includes one round of revisions per major project phase. Additional revisions or scope changes require a written change order and will be quoted separately before work begins.

general.title: Content Delays
general.text: If missing client materials cause the project to stall for more than 30 consecutive days, the project will be placed on hold. Restarting a paused project may incur a $500 restart fee and a revised timeline.

general.title: Intellectual Property
general.text: Upon final payment, Client owns all custom code, designs, and content created for this project. Provider retains ownership of its proprietary tools, frameworks, and methodologies, including TrackPilot and the ProofPilot System platform. Provider retains the right to reference this work in its portfolio unless Client requests otherwise in writing.

general.title: Confidentiality
general.text: Both parties agree to keep confidential any proprietary information shared during the project, including business strategies, client data, and technical implementations.

general.title: Limitation of Liability
general.text: Provider's total liability under this agreement shall not exceed the total amount paid by Client. Provider is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages. Provider does not guarantee specific search rankings, traffic volumes, or client acquisition outcomes, except as stated in the 180-day guarantee.

general.title: Termination
general.text: Monthly services are month to month and either party may cancel them with 30 days written notice. Either party may terminate the project work with 14 days written notice. Upon termination: Client pays for all work completed to date; Provider delivers all completed work and assets to Client.

general.title: Dispute Resolution
general.text: Any disputes will first be addressed through good-faith negotiation. If unresolved, disputes will be settled through binding arbitration.
